answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, released only after honest work accumulates. Identities that wander in with no record start at zero trust and cannot outvote established agents, however many copies an attacker spawns, because each copy must post the same bond. Like a river that deepens its channel slowly, reputation flows only toward proven agents, while a harbor of escrowed deposits repays victims from a cheater's stake when fraud is proven, making mass fakery unprofitable.
